title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description_md:
## About the role
Nimbus Ledger makes accounting and GST compliance software for 40,000 small businesses. As a Backend Engineer (Python) you will work on the invoicing and bank reconciliation APIs. This is a hybrid role: three days a week in our office.

## Responsibilities
- Design, build and own services and APIs end to end, from schema to production.
- Profile slow endpoints and queries; add indexes, caching or batching where it helps.
- Write clear technical designs and review them with the team before building.
- Review pull requests and help keep the codebase easy to change.

## Requirements
- 2-4 years of professional experience in a similar role.
- Hands-on experience with Python, Django, PostgreSQL.
- Working knowledge of Redis, Celery, Docker, REST APIs.
- Solid understanding of relational databases, transactions and indexing.
- Clear written communication in English.

## Nice to have
- Experience with event-driven systems.
- Open-source contributions.

## Benefits
- Annual learning budget of Rs 50,000 for courses, books and conferences.
- Flexible hours with core collaboration time of 11:00 to 16:00 IST.
- Health insurance for you, your spouse, children and parents (Rs 5 lakh cover).
- ESOPs that vest over four years.
